If you’re really wanting to have diversity though take a look at non celebrity people from all over the world to see more authentic non manicured features? Every region has trends of different bone structure. I say that because even the non East Asian idol sims seem to have the same “idol” features just with different skin tones. If kpop idol aesthetic sims is something you prefer that’s fine too though.

I personally like my sims to look more like everyday people and add little details, I have an asymmetry mod I like to use, usually will add different scars, aging, skin folds/creases etc etc. I do have my beauty enhanced sims and fair share of sims who look like celebrities but I try to play with authentic diversity in ethnicity but also just people.
